definitions: Pushes or pulls a hard or sharp implement across a surface or object.
Removes an outer layer from something by using a tight-fitting edge.
Injures or damages a surface by rubbing it against something rough.
Manages to achieve something with great difficulty.
examples: He scrapes the ice off the windscreen.
She scrapes her knee on the pavement.
The cat scrapes at the door.
He just scrapes through his exams.
